report.title: The nested checklist cannot display levels correctly
report.body: ### Pre-submission Checklist - [x] I have searched the existing issues and this bug has not been reported yet - [x] I have tested this issue on the [demo site](https://demo.usememos.com) or the latest version ### Where did you encounter this bug? Latest stable version (self-hosted) ### Memos Version v0.26.0 ### Bug Description The nested checklist cannot display levels correctly; all items appear on the same level. Furthermore, clicking the checkbox of a sub-checklist incorrectly marks the item above it. The syntax for nested checklists was correctly supported in previous versions. ### Steps to Reproduce The testing markdown is ```markdown - [ ] task1 - [ ] task1.1 - [ ] task 1.1.1 - [ ] task1.2 - [ ] task2 ``` ### Expected Behavior _No response_ ### Screenshots & Additional Context _No response_

steps: Click the memo editor input on the home page

Type the line ' - [ ] task1.2 ' (indented by 4 spaces) and press Enter
Click the Save button to save the memo
View the rendered memo in the memo list
plan.expected: The rendered memo shows task1.1 and task1.2 indented one level under task1, and task 1.1.1 indented two levels under task1, with task2 at the top level, rather than all items appearing on the same level
plan.reported_actual: All checklist items are displayed at the same level, and clicking the checkbox of a sub-item marks the item above it instead
missing: assumed: the indentation in the report is 4 spaces per nesting level
assumed: the memo editor may auto-continue list markers or auto-indent on Enter, so typed lines may need adjusting
The reporter gave no explicit expected behavior; assumed nested items should render indented as in previous versions
Which checkbox exactly was clicked when the wrong item was marked
plan.summary: Nested checklist items render at the same level and sub-item checkbox toggles the wrong item

Steps:

7. Click the Save button to save the memo
8. View the rendered memo in the memo list
